summary_1line: Bhishma advises Yudhishthira on ideal royal cities, fortifications, governance, spies, treatment of subjects, and the administrative hierarchy needed to stabilize a kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: A vast fortified city with high walls, trenches, elephants, chariots, markets, and temples ringing with Vedic chants and music.
A king humbly offering gifts and seats to austere forest ascetics while listening to their counsel.
Royal spies quietly observing townspeople and reporting to officials in a layered hierarchy of village and provincial administrators.
